description:
Cast Encroaching Mycosynth by paying {3}{U}.
When Encroaching Mycosynth enters the battlefield, Simulacrum Synthesizer's second ability triggers, creating a 0/0 Contruct artifact creature token that enters the battlefield as a copy of Essence of the Wild.
When the Essence of the Wild token enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth, Simulacrum Synthesizer's second ability triggers, creating a 0/0 Contruct artifact creature token that enters the battlefield as a copy of Essence of the Wild.
Repeat step 3.
